title: subsys schc CMakeLists lists schc_failure_tracker.c twice (merge artifact)
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/CMakeLists.txt:13 and :15 both list schc_failure_tracker.c — a conflict-resolution artifact of merge commit f94dd6289f (both parents added it at different positions). Harmless today (CMake dedupes identical source paths in one target) but should be reduced to a single entry. Found during edge-cases review of xft7.
